messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: metering.ingest.consumer-lag > 10k (prod)
pagerduty: Paging: @eng-sre-oncall (high) — metering ingestion backlog increased dramatically.
olivia: seeing the page, joining. any customer-facing impact yet?
devon: looking now — Kafka consumer group 'metering-ingest' lag is ~11234 partitions behind, scroll of errors in the worker logs.
maya: logs show repeated IllegalArgumentException from tokenizer: 'unexpected token id' for a small fraction of messages, but bulk is just slow processing.
olivia: can we confirm whether the token counters are incrementing? If counts stopped, invoices might be wrong for today.
devon: quick check: prometheus -> metering.tokens.count shows a flatline starting ~00:15 UTC. metering.ingest.throughput dropped 70%.
eng-sre-oncall: marking impact: potential incorrect token counts and delayed invoice generation. @billing-lead FYI.
billing-lead: thanks — if counters are paused, invoices for a handful of large customers could be undercounted. we may need to hold invoice run until backfill completes.
olivia: immediate mitigation plan: 1) restart consumer deployment to recover throughput 2) temporarily scale consumers x2 3) isolate bad messages to a quarantine topic for backfill.
devon: on it — running:```bash
kubectl -n metering rollout restart deployment/metering-consumer
kubectl -n metering scale deployment/metering-consumer --replicas=6
```
(devon uploads logs snippet)
devon: restart kicked, pods coming up. seeing warmup spike then processing resumes on many partitions. still about 7k lag.
maya: creating quarantine topic `metering-quarantine-183950` and forwarding problematic messages there:```bash
kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --topic metering-raw --property print.key=true | grep "IllegalArgumentException" > quarantine-ids.txt
# then produce selected ids to metering-quarantine-183950
```
olivia: good. can we set a temporary alert suppression for noisy tokenization errors so it doesn't cascade? I don't want repetitive pages while we recover.
eng-sre-oncall: suppressing PD for rule metering.tokenizer.errors for 30m. documenting in incident timeline.
devon: throughput back to ~65% within 12 minutes of scale/restart. lag down to ~2.2k.
maya: running quick backfill job for quarantined messages into a safe reprocess queue. estimate 40m for full catch-up if steady throughput holds.
billing-lead: start a short customer impact note: we may delay invoice run by up to 2 hours for accuracy. If customers see discrepancies, route them to support with this incident id.
olivia: assigning actions: devon — keep scaling and monitor lag until <500; maya — finish quarantine backfill + validate token counts; billing-lead — prepare invoice hold and comms draft.
devon: acknowledged. adding a temporary autoscaler override policy to keep replicas=6 until lag < 500:```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  minReplicas: 6
  maxReplicas: 12
```
eng-sre-oncall: noting escalation path: if lag doesn't drop under 1k in 20m, we escalate to eng-runtime and eng-ml for deeper trace.
(devon posts metric screenshot)
devon: lag at 480 — nice. consumers are processing quarantined queue too.
maya: token counters resumed and now incrementing. running compare job: diff between live counts and replayed counts for sample customers. initial check: discrepancy <0.2% for sampled customers.
billing-lead: that discrepancy is acceptable. we'll proceed with invoice run but hold finalization for 30m until full validation. drafting support note now.
olivia: moving to recovery phase. steps to close: revert replica override, delete quarantine topic after 24h retention, run full reconciliation job and log results.
eng-sre-oncall: thanks everyone. summary to be posted to #incidents and incident tracker with mitigation timeline and customer-impact classification: 'degraded metering accuracy (minor, temporary hold)'.
devon: one follow-up: add more robust schema validation earlier in pipeline to avoid tokenizer exceptions taking down consumers. filing ticket ENG-6412.
maya: also propose backpressure metrics + an alert that ties consumer lag to invoice runs so billing doesn't start while lag > threshold. filing ENG-6413.
olivia: ack. incident-bot: close?
incident-bot: Incident resolved: metering.ingest.consumer-lag alert cleared. Time to acknowledge: 43 minutes.
pagerduty: Incident closed by @olivia.
billing-lead: sending final note to billing ops and support. will follow up if reconciliation finds anything odd. :white_check_mark:
